title: Crude Oil Mini Lot Size on MCX: 10 Barrels, Tick Value and Margin
summary: One Crude Oil Mini lot on MCX is 10 barrels. See the CRUDEOILM tick value, how to calculate one lot’s P&L, margin requirements and expiry dates.
body_markdown:
**One lot of Crude Oil Mini (CRUDEOILM) on MCX is 10 barrels.** Its futures price is quoted in rupees per barrel. A ₹1 move changes one lot’s P&L by ₹10 before charges. For example, if you buy one lot and the price rises by ₹100 per barrel, your gross profit is ₹1,000.

## How to Calculate the Value and Margin of 1 Crude Oil Mini Lot


To get the contract value, multiply the price per barrel by 10. Futures traders and option sellers then deposit margin, which is a share of that value.


One Crude Oil Mini lot on 3 November 2026


Futures price

Margin (31.25%,)


₹28,374


Futures P&L per ₹1 move


₹10


A standard Crude Oil lot needed ₹2,83,540 that day, about ten times as much. Margin changes with price and volatility, so check the latest figure in the[AlgoTest margin calculator](https://algotest.in/margin-calculator) . Our[MCX margin](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-margin/) guide explains how it is set.


Option buyers pay the full premium upfront instead of margin. If an option is held near expiry and may turn into a futures position, the broker can require additional margin before expiry.


## Crude Oil Mini vs Crude Oil


-


Ten Crude Oil Mini lots represent the same 100-barrel quantity as one standard[Crude Oil lot](https://algotest.in/blog/crude-oil-lot-size/) .


-


Crude Oil Mini moves ₹10 for every ₹1 change per barrel, while standard Crude Oil moves ₹100.


-


Both contracts expire on the same day, both are settled in cash and both have options.


-


Choose the contract size that fits your risk limit, and check its liquidity and bid-ask spread before you trade. Our[position size calculator](https://algotest.in/blog/position-size-calculator/) guide shows how to work out the number of lots.

## Crude Oil Mini Options


crude oil option chain on AlgoTest


MCX launched options on Crude Oil Mini futures on 23 April 2024. Premiums are quoted per barrel, so a call trading at ₹200 costs ₹200 × 10 = ₹2,000 per lot.


-


An in-the-money option held to expiry normally turns into a Crude Oil Mini futures position, unless the long holder submits a valid contrary instruction.


-


Option P&L depends on how the premium changes, so it does not move one-for-one with the futures price.

## Crude Oil Mini Expiry Dates and Trading Hours


Options expire two business days before their futures. Exercised options become futures positions, and the futures are then settled in cash at a price linked to US NYMEX WTI crude oil.

The current non-agricultural MCX session runs from 9:00 AM to 11:55 PM IST until 12 March 2027. See[MCX trading time](https://algotest.in/blog/mcx-trading-time/) for later sessions. Your broker’s square-off cutoff can be earlier than the exchange close, so check it too.

### FAQs


#### How much margin is needed for 1 lot of Crude Oil Mini?


On 3 November 2026, one November Crude Oil Mini futures lot needed ₹28,374 (31.25%) at ₹9,079 per barrel. Margin changes daily, so check the current figure before you trade.


#### What is the tick value of Crude Oil Mini futures and options?


The futures tick is ₹1 per barrel, worth ₹10 per lot. The option premium tick is ₹0.05 per barrel, worth ₹0.50 per lot.


#### When does Crude Oil Mini expire?


The November 2026 options expire on 17 November and the futures on 19 November. In December, the options expire on 16 December and the futures on 18 December.
